```{r setup}
library(igraph)
library(adaptagrams)
```

The returned object remains an igraph graph. Coordinates describe rectangle
centers and the route list contains the connector geometry.

```{r example}
graph <- make_ring(5)
result <- layout_and_route(graph)
coordinates <- layout_matrix(result)
routes <- get_edge_routes(result)
```

Use `coordinates` as the `layout` argument for `plot.igraph`. Routed connector
geometry is custom data and must be rendered separately:

```{r plot, eval=FALSE}
plot(result, layout = coordinates, edge.color = NA)
for (route in igraph::edge_attr(result, "adaptagrams_route")) {
    lines(route[, 1], route[, 2])
}
```
